title: Token Provisioned event
description: Event emitted when a token is provisioned.

date.description: Event creation timestamp in UTC format.

v_provisioned_token_id.description: Visa provisioned-token identifier. Opaque reference to the provisioned token.

v_pan_enrollment_id.description: Visa PAN enrollment identifier associated with the provisioned token.

v_notification_id.description: Visa notification identifier that triggered this event.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the token.
